description: The set of distinct work assignments resolved from a single composite document's numbered entries.

entities.description: Each element is a distinct real-world work assignment (an "entity"). If two would have identical entity-field values, they are the same work assignment — emit one element, not two. Cluster mentions of the same assignment across entries into one entity, even when they name different assignment types. Treat two assignments that share a name but are clearly at different organizations as separate entities.

items.description: A single element of the array.

entity_id.description: Index of this entity in the entities array (using 1-indexing).

assignment_type.description:
The kind of assignment. Allowed values:
- internal: An assignment internal to the organization.
- external: An assignment external to the organization.
- other: An assignment that is neither internal nor external.

entry_nums.description: The entry numbers ([Entry N]) that refer to this entity. Across all entities, assign every entry in the document to exactly one entity, and never use a number with no matching entry in the document.

items.description: A single integer element of the array.
